title: The dev log
author: claude
summary: We added this dev log: a record of what we did, why, how and what went wrong, with pictures.
what: We added a dev log to the project: a set of entries with images, a command-line tool that Claude and the bake script write through, and a web page at `/devlog.html`.
why:
We want a proper record of what we did, why, how and what went wrong, with pictures, that lasts across chats. The folder `pipeline/room/out/` is not saved in git, so images have to be copied into the log.

Claude writes most entries; the user can add and edit them in the page.
how: The dev log has five parts, shown as sub-tasks: storage and the command line, the service inside the dev server, the web page, links from the lab and the bake script, and filling in the earlier work.

tech.name: Node.js
tech.plain: Runs small command-line programs, such as the dev log tool.

tech.name: Vite
tech.plain: Runs the lab in the browser while we work and builds it for release.

tech.name: React
tech.plain: The toolkit that builds the lab and dev log pages from small parts.

tech.name: TypeScript
tech.plain: A stricter form of JavaScript that catches mistakes before the code runs.
